I am in Afar where the rains are unpredictable and my sorghum field depends on what the sky gives us. With no schooling, I do not know much about chemical fertilizers from the cooperatives, and the road to town is far, so I will plant the same local sorghum seed my father used and rely on my family’s hands. We will prepare the land when the rains come, weed when needed, and harvest together without paying outside workers since our land is small and money is tight.
